personality.description: This person is imaginative and intellectually restless, often exploring unconventional ideas, collecting new information, and revising their views when something feels more compelling. In daily habits, they keep a workable level of order but prefer enough flexibility to change plans, and they are likely to spend time alone thinking, researching, or refining personal interests. When faced with moral dilemmas, they tend to analyze the situation carefully while also protecting their own interests, and their skepticism can make them slow to trust others’ stated intentions. In group discussions, they usually speak sparingly, choose words carefully, and may sound guarded, critical, or analytical, especially if they feel uncertain or under pressure.
traits: has assertively moved up the ranks into positions of leadership
prioritizes having control and authority over others
makes quick and definitive decisions, and once a decision is made it is usually final
has their own views of how tasks should be accomplished
uses reward and punishment to get people to follow their ideas
